title: The World
description: 1 captured save. One original BASIC player; historical bugs remain.
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: THE WORLD
versions.note: validated payload; needs Disk BASIC. Payload byte-identical across 4 variants; stock Model I and III ROM tests stop with L3 error at INSTR in line 70
versions.startupSource:
10 ' THE WORLD
20 CLEAR 500
30 L=RND(8):FORX=1TOL:W$=CHR$(RND(26)+64)+W$:NEXT
40 CLS
50 PRINT:PRINT:PRINT:PRINT"WELCOME TO THE PLANET OF";W$:L$="ARGON'S CITY GATES":GOTO70   
60 CLS:RESTORE
70 READD$:IFD$="DONE"THEN100  ELSEIF INSTR(D$,L$)=0OR INSTR(D$,"*")<>0THEN70   
80 IFRIGHT$(D$,1)="&"THENPRINTLEFT$(D$,LEN(D$)-1);:READD$:GOTO80   ELSEPRINTD$
90 GOTO110  
100 PRINT:PRINT:PRINT:PRINT"I'M SORRY BUT AT THE PRESENT TIME ";L$;" IS OFF LIMITS TO YOU."
110 PRINT:INPUT"WHAT ARE YOUR ORDERS";O$
120 IFO$="HELP"THEN270

attribution.text: Original author and any earlier published source have not been established. Preserved here as recovered cassette material.
